description:
You are the DHIS2 System Administrator. The new 'Kenema District Health Team' needs a shared dashboard to view their district's health data. 

Your goal is to perform the following administrative setup in DHIS2 (http://localhost:8080, admin/district):

1. Create a new User Group named 'Kenema District Health Team'. Add the 'admin' user as a member of this group.
2. Create a new Dashboard named 'Kenema Health Overview'. Add at least one dashboard item to it (e.g., a text box with a description or an existing visualization).
3. Configure Sharing for this new dashboard so that the 'Kenema District Health Team' user group has 'Can view' access (read-only). Do not give them edit access.

Ensure all three steps are completed correctly.
